findings.note: Complains that the exact-prefix trigger pin (tests/diff_template.rs:155) is too strict for future edits; that strictness is by design (the pins are strict on purpose) and nothing fails today.
True that only the first actions/checkout is checked (diff_template.rs:180-194), but the workflow has exactly one checkout, so this only matters if a second one is added later.
req-diff.yml:7-9 does put weakened in the blocking set and then calls it 'not a rejection by req'; the wording could confuse a reader, but the comment does say --fail-on is what blocks.
The install step needs secrets.REQ_RELEASE_TOKEN (req-diff.yml:36,83-85) and refuses without it, so the check is red on fork PRs; neither the header nor the adopting section says so.
out=$(mktemp) (req-diff.yml:181) is never removed; on self-hosted runners that leaves a small temp file per run.

The step runs under set -u and writes >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" with no default (req-diff.yml:180,194), and the file says it can be copied to <removed forgejo workflows>; if the variable is unset, a passing diff fails the step.

The section needles (diff_template.rs:476-509) do not pin the exit-code/UNVERIFIABLE wording; the 'why' text says 'shallow clone is UNVERIFIABLE' but only fetch-depth: 0 is checked. A small doc-pin gap.
